ideas.pitch: An automated symbolic execution and input-output test case generator that reconstructs hidden mathematical functions from black-box evaluation outputs.
ideas.problem_statement: Reverse CodingX – Shaastra 2027: Reverse Coding questions where participants will be expected to code a program that gives a correct output for the question based on logical reasoning and number systems.
ideas.title: ReverseInfer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core mechanical challenge of the reverse-coding contest by leveraging constraint solvers and deterministic logic to deduce code structure, echoing the technical difficulty pattern seen in top hackathon wins.

ideas.pitch: A visual pattern-spotting debugger that matches input-output sequences against common algorithmic templates like modular arithmetic, bitwise operations, and recursive series.
ideas.problem_statement: Reverse CodingX – Shaastra 2027: Spot the patterns and crack the logic behind the code using logical reasoning and number systems.
ideas.title: LogicTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an individual competitor with a live, highly useful utility to rapidly test hypotheses against multi-testcase outputs during intense time constraints.

ideas.pitch: An AST-based synthesis engine that takes a series of execution traces and generates a syntactically valid C or Python script passing all hidden test cases.
ideas.problem_statement: Reverse CodingX – Shaastra 2027: Participants will be expected to code a program that gives a correct output for the question.
ideas.title: CodeReconstructor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on building a fully functional and demonstrable utility that automates the precise output-to-code workflow required by the hackathon's final round.

ideas.pitch: An interactive playground for rapid prototyping of number system transformations, sequence identification, and logical puzzle solving.
ideas.problem_statement: Reverse CodingX – Shaastra 2027: Each prelim will comprise logical and programming-based questions involving some basic concepts on logical reasoning, number systems.
ideas.title: PatternMatrix
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate pain point for participants dealing with tricky number theory and sequence puzzles under strict time limits.

ideas.pitch: A reinforcement learning guided search tool that explores parameter spaces to reverse-engineer obfuscated mathematical functions from sparse telemetry.
ideas.problem_statement: Reverse CodingX – Shaastra 2027: Crack the code, spot the patterns, and prove your mettle as the ultimate logic champion by working backwards from an output.
ideas.title: BlindSynth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by combining heuristic search with constraint propagation to solve black-box code challenges.
